artist_statement.text:
“মুক্তিযুদ্ধ - Fight for Freedom”


Two women. One window each. One world between them. Defiance vs Chosen invisibility. 

The window is the threshold — neither inside nor outside, neither fully citizen nor fully free. The train itself is civic machinery: ticketed, tracked, timetabled by bureaucratic hands.

Below them, a torn poster of মুক্তিযুদ্ধ (Bangladesh Liberation War) reminiscing our fight for freedom  . A ghost of protest. A reminder that freedom is never declared once. It is claimed, daily, at every threshold you dare to lean through.

Location – Dhaka, Bangladesh

Year – 2020

Nikon D7200 & Nikon 50mm

Collage made in Photoshop
